status: engineered circular sensor-fusion experiment; not a biological implementation
truth_boundary: true heading is used only by score(); estimate_headings accepts SensorInputs containing visual, odometry, and the explicitly labeled oracle reliability control
protocol: constants and seeds frozen before the 20-seed evaluation; algorithms share each generated sensor/disturbance stream

algorithm_notes.innovation_gate: fixed hand-selected innovation thresholds; heuristic, not learned reliability
algorithm_notes.oracle_reliability: positive control supplied with scenario reliability labels unavailable to the non-oracle methods
algorithm_notes.no_vision: initialized from the first visual observation, then integrates odometry without further vision; this calibration favors it over a never-calibrated odometry-only system

bootstrap_units.all_scenarios: 20 paired seed means across six scenarios (cluster bootstrap by seed)
